source: scripts/sync_mapper.py (this skill is the sole maintainer since 2026-09-11; the vault-side generate_map.py is retired)
changes: annotation and wikilink masking including multiline notes
expected physical pages for coverage auditing
page range offsets for multi-volume files (--page-range-offset)
catalog rebuild records only a vault-relative config path (--rebuild-config); no machine paths
merged bodies: chapter headings take their first printed page from frontmatter chapter_metadata

chapter_metadata is read by YAML indentation: nested lists are not new entries, flow sequences (pages: [61, 80]) are understood, one quote pair is stripped, and a repeated title keeps the first entry's page
headings and frontmatter titles share one normalization, and a heading title is taken from the block's first line only
parse_offset_config is shared with pdf_sync so a dry run cannot disagree with the real run; incomplete page range offsets raise one friendly message
catalog entries merge with the previous record (fields a run does not supply are kept) and are written atomically via os.replace
--pages removed from the mapper CLI: only --rerun-pages remains, and it forces a cache refresh without limiting the run

line recovery is det-v2: the crop bleeds about half a block height of white space on every side before detection (a one-line footnote cropped tight is an unreadable 25px strip), boxes centred outside the original block are dropped, and boxes sharing a text row are merged so the footnote marker joins its sentence instead of standing as its own line

detection that covers less than half the block by height OR by area is treated as a miss - a lone circled marker spans the full height on a twentieth of the width - and falls back: a block no taller than 1.6 body line heights (0.025 normalized where the page has no line boxes at all) is read whole, a taller one is cut by horizontal projection whose row gap calibrates on the block's own bands, so a text block can never end up with no line box

the detection cache key carries the algorithm version (LINE_DETECTION_ALGORITHM), so a recipe change retires the results of the previous one while the pNNNN.json recognition caches keep their append path

line-less text blocks (page_footnote above all, plus index/ref_text/image_caption/image_footnote/aside_text) get their line boxes from PP-OCRv5_mobile_det detection run on the block crop only; running heads, page numbers, footers, tables and formulas are deliberately excluded so alignment gets no text the Markdown lacks
the OCR cache filename carries a short hash of the page's whole line set (p0024-<hash8>.json), so a page whose line set grew can no longer hide behind an old cache file

a pre-supplement p0024.json cache is reused instead of discarded: only the supplementary lines are recognized and their characters are appended after the cached ones, which holds because those lines are read last
detected line boxes are cached under lines/p0024-<blockhash>.json, so a repeat run needs neither a page render nor the detection model
compatibility: MinerU PDF Sync sidecar schema version 1
maintenance: Bundled snapshot. Update deliberately with mapper tests and sidecar compatibility checks; never overwrite a local plugin automatically.
